messages.content: Objective: produce a competitor landscape for the AI note-taking market by 2026-11-07.
I'll start with the top 10 vendors by funding and summarise pricing, target segment and differentiators.
Only use public sources. Do not log in to any competitor product with our accounts.

content.text: Understood. I've finished the first pass on 6 vendors; notes are in /workspace/research/notes-ai-notetakers.md.

messages.content: Decision: exclude vendors with fewer than 50 employees.
Open question: should we include Microsoft Copilot as a competitor or as a platform?
Next steps: finish the remaining 4 vendors and draft the comparison table in /workspace/research/landscape.xlsx.
